title: Coby the Little Trolley and the City of Sleepy Lights
description: A little teal trolley carries rabbit Marlo, hedgehog Cleo, and raccoon Otis home through a city of sleepy lights, then rests in his shed under the moon.

Coby.role: Main character; a compact vintage electric streetcar
Coby.color: Soft teal-blue lower body with a warm ivory upper cabin, thin butter-yellow stripe, rounded charcoal-gray roof, and a round amber headlamp
Coby.bodyShape: Single-car toy-like trolley with four rounded rectangular side windows, two small dark wheels per side, and one slim charcoal trolley pole; no arms, hands, legs, smokestack, or freight cars
Coby.face: Two expressive oval eyes and a small warm smile on the cream front fascia below the windshield
Coby.accessories: Small golden bell above the front windshield and one central round amber headlamp

Marlo.role: Supporting passenger; a cinnamon-brown rabbit who exits on page 11
Marlo.color: Cinnamon-brown fur with peach inner ears and a tiny cream muzzle
Marlo.bodyShape: Small rounded rabbit with short floppy ears; no human limbs
Marlo.face: Dark button eyes and a gentle expression
Marlo.accessories: Sage-green knitted vest and one small moss-green blanket

Cleo.role: Supporting passenger; a cream hedgehog who exits on page 12
Cleo.color: Cream body with short soft caramel-brown quills and peach cheeks
Cleo.bodyShape: Small round hedgehog; no human limbs
Cleo.face: Black bead eyes and a tiny dark nose
Cleo.accessories: Dusty-rose scarf and one round butter-yellow pillow

Otis.role: Supporting passenger; a slate-blue raccoon who exits on page 13
Otis.color: Slate-blue fur with a pale gray facial mask and a subtle dark-striped tail
Otis.bodyShape: Small rounded raccoon with rounded ears; no human limbs
Otis.face: Dark button eyes and a sleepy gentle expression
Otis.accessories: Mustard-yellow neckerchief and one small closed powder-blue book with a blank cover

settingBible.City of Sleepy Lights: A compact storybook canal city with cobblestone streets, tram rails, overhead trolley wires, pastel townhouses, golden streetlamps, a short stone canal bridge, and a brick trolley station with an open-front shed
settingBible.visualStyle: Warm polished 3D children's illustration, soft rounded trolley and animal passengers, peach evening fading to velvet navy night, one scene per page, and no readable text on story pages

continuityRules: Coby keeps teal body, ivory cabin, yellow stripe, golden bell, amber headlamp, and one trolley pole.
Exactly three passengers: Marlo with green blanket, Cleo with yellow pillow, and Otis with blank blue book.
Marlo exits on page 11, Cleo on page 12, and Otis on page 13; Coby is empty on pages 14–15.
Their neighboring doors stay sage green, pale yellow, and powder blue.
No rescue, danger, crowds, lettering, logos, shop names, or writing on Otis's book.
Every illustration is one continuous scene with no panels, collage, grid, text, badge, logo, or readable words on story-page artwork.

pages.text: When the evening sky turned peach and purple, Coby the little trolley rolled out for his very last trip of the day.
pages.illustrationScene: Teal trolley Coby waits on curved tracks beside a brick trolley station under a peach-lavender sunset.
pages.continuityNotes: Coby present; teal trolley with ivory cabin and golden bell. Passengers may wait on the platform but are not required in narration yet.

pages.text: All aboard for the sleepy ride home, Coby chimed, ringing his little golden bell.
pages.illustrationScene: Rabbit Marlo, hedgehog Cleo, and raccoon Otis climb aboard smiling Coby under his glowing headlamp.
pages.continuityNotes: Coby present; teal trolley with ivory cabin and golden bell. All three passengers aboard with blanket, pillow, and blank blue book.

pages.text: Marlo carried a tiny green blanket, Cleo hugged a round yellow pillow, and Otis held his favorite little blue book.
pages.illustrationScene: Inside Coby's cabin, Marlo, Cleo, and Otis sit together on warm wooden benches with blanket, pillow, and blue book.
pages.continuityNotes: Coby present; teal trolley with ivory cabin and golden bell. All three passengers aboard with blanket, pillow, and blank blue book.

pages.text: Clickety-clack, clickety-clack, Coby followed the shining rails past the bakery with its golden windows.
pages.illustrationScene: Coby travels a cobblestone street past a bakery with golden windows while the three passengers ride inside.
pages.continuityNotes: Coby present; teal trolley with ivory cabin and golden bell. All three passengers aboard with blanket, pillow, and blank blue book.

pages.text: The city lamps blinked on one by one, like little stars waking up along the sidewalks.
pages.illustrationScene: Wide view of Coby beneath glowing golden streetlamps as the three passengers gaze through the windows.
pages.continuityNotes: Coby present; teal trolley with ivory cabin and golden bell. All three passengers aboard with blanket, pillow, and blank blue book.

pages.text: Marlo gave a great big yawn, but he still whispered that the lights looked like sleepy fireflies.
pages.illustrationScene: Interior view of yawning Marlo with his green blanket, Cleo hugging her yellow pillow, and Otis holding his blue book.
pages.continuityNotes: Coby present; teal trolley with ivory cabin and golden bell. All three passengers aboard with blanket, pillow, and blank blue book.

pages.text: At the little bridge, Coby slowed down so everyone could see the moon making silver ribbons on the water.
pages.illustrationScene: Coby crosses a short stone bridge over a narrow canal with silver moonlight on the water.
pages.continuityNotes: Coby present; teal trolley with ivory cabin and golden bell. All three passengers aboard with blanket, pillow, and blank blue book.

pages.text: Cleo watched the moonlit water and whispered that the river looked like it was wearing a bedtime blanket.
pages.illustrationScene: Through Coby's side window, Cleo hugs her pillow while watching the shimmering canal with Marlo and Otis nearby.
pages.continuityNotes: Coby present; teal trolley with ivory cabin and golden bell. All three passengers aboard with blanket, pillow, and blank blue book.

pages.text: Around the next corner, Otis spotted little windows glowing high above the quiet street.
pages.illustrationScene: Coby rounds a curve into a quiet neighborhood with warm upstairs windows as Otis looks out holding his blue book.
pages.continuityNotes: Coby present; teal trolley with ivory cabin and golden bell. All three passengers aboard with blanket, pillow, and blank blue book.

pages.text: Those are our windows, Otis whispered, and together their homes are waiting for them.
pages.illustrationScene: Coby pauses by a shared courtyard as the three animals look toward sage-green, pale-yellow, and powder-blue doors.
pages.continuityNotes: Coby present; teal trolley with ivory cabin and golden bell. All three passengers aboard with blanket, pillow, and blank blue book.

pages.text: First Marlo hopped down, wrapping his soft green blanket around his shoulders like a cozy little cape.
pages.illustrationScene: Marlo stands on the sidewalk outside his sage-green door in his green blanket while Coby waits with doors open.
pages.continuityNotes: Coby present; teal trolley with ivory cabin and golden bell. Marlo exits; Cleo and Otis still aboard.

pages.text: Next Cleo tiptoed home, holding her yellow pillow close and giving Coby a tiny sleepy wave.
pages.illustrationScene: Cleo walks toward the pale-yellow doorway with her round pillow while Otis remains aboard Coby.
pages.continuityNotes: Coby present; teal trolley with ivory cabin and golden bell. Cleo exits; Otis still aboard.

pages.text: Last came Otis, who whispered good night and thank you for the prettiest ride through the lights.
pages.illustrationScene: Otis stands outside his powder-blue doorway looking back at Coby under a starry navy night.
pages.continuityNotes: Coby present; teal trolley with ivory cabin and golden bell. Otis exits; Coby becoming empty.

pages.text: Coby rang his bell just once, very softly, and rolled back alone through the peaceful, sleeping city.
pages.illustrationScene: Coby travels alone along moonlit tracks toward the brick trolley station with empty passenger seats.
pages.continuityNotes: Coby present; teal trolley with ivory cabin and golden bell. Coby alone and empty.

pages.text: With his headlamp glowing low and the moon shining above, Coby closed his eyes and dreamed of tomorrow's lovely little ride.
pages.illustrationScene: Coby rests asleep in the open-front trolley shed with closed eyes and a dim amber headlamp under silver moonlight.
pages.continuityNotes: Coby present; teal trolley with ivory cabin and golden bell. Coby alone and empty. Final shed sleep; eyes closed.
